title: Join, Move, Look, and Communicate
outcome: Child can join the prepared world, walk and jump where they choose, turn their view to look at things, and use push-to-talk or in-game gesture to respond during play.
testedVersions: 1.21.x (Bedrock) - verify current patch at session prep
multiplayerRequirements: Solo: prepared local world. Shared: adult-owned Realm or LAN world with child + mentor only.
knownIncompatibilities: Java Edition controls differ - do not mix instructions

guardianSteps: Sign the child into Minecraft Bedrock before the session starts
Confirm audio works (headphones recommended) and the video call is open
Have the device charged and seated comfortably
mentorPreflight: Verify world 'BB Starter Plains' loads with flat grass area and creative mode
Confirm voice channel: child can hear you and you can hear them
Check input method from intake form; prepare the matching control card

mentorMoves: Ask what they played or built since last time
If first session: ask what they already know about Minecraft
Offer two concrete choices: 'Walk around and find something cool' or 'Build a little spot'
Narrate controls once per action using the control card
Celebrate the first successful move loudly
Demonstrate looking around by moving the view slowly
Ask 'What do you think happens if you keep walking that way?'

flow.childAction: Leads a mini-adventure to a place they pick

mentorMoves: Offer: change how you move (sprint/jump) or go a different direction
Ask them to give it a tour or a name
Record what they want next: build? animals? more exploring?

openingLines: Hey! Ready to explore your world today?
Before we start, show me your screen - is Minecraft open?
keyPhrases: You're driving - tell me where to go!
Want to try it yourself or should I show you first?

learnerCues.cueText: Hold this button when you want to talk

sharedRoles.childRole: Explorer - decides where to go and what to try
sharedRoles.mentorRole: Guide - narrates controls once, then follows
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: In small groups, alternate who picks the destination each round

commonProblems.problem: Child cannot find the joystick/move button
commonProblems.fix: Show the control card for THEIR input method; point on screen share; avoid taking control
Reduce camera speed in settings, take a look-away break, switch to pointing at landmarks
Guardian mutes game audio OR call audio; mentor lowers volume

hintLadder: Which way do you want to go? Let's find the button together.
Look at the left side of your screen - see that circle/arrow?
Put your finger/thumb right there... now slide up gently.
resetPath: Return to spawn point (mentor uses /tp or walks back with them). If controls feel scrambled, pause and re-show the control card. No progress lost - exploring has no wrong answers.
soloFallback: If multiplayer fails: child explores the same starter world solo while mentor guides by voice/screen-share. Same goals apply.
accessibilityOptions: Auto-jump ON so jumping isn't a separate skill
Mentor narration replaces all text reading
Touch OR controller OR mouse - whichever the intake form says the child uses
safetyRequirements: Private world or Realm owned by a coordinator/adult; no public servers
No mentor-child direct messages outside guardian-visible channels
Mentor never asks for account credentials; guardian handles sign-in
Session communication on approved video-call platform only
parentSummaryTemplate: Today {child} learned to move and look around in their own Minecraft world. They chose where to explore and found {highlight}. Ask them about {namedSpot}!

review.notes: Technically valid against Bedrock 1.21 defaults; needs human playtest with an actual 7-year-old on each input method before published.

worldSpecification.description: 'BB Starter Plains': Flat world, creative mode, clear weather, spawn on open grass with visible landmarks within ~30 blocks: one large oak tree, a pond, gentle hills.
